text:
Harold (AE): Rena asked us to finalize the POC success criteria before EOD. She wants a 3-week sandbox, production-like replay, and security sign-off. Their immediate asks:
- perf: p95 latency <= 220ms for single-turn queries under peak mix
- cost: target <= $275 / 1M request-equivalents
- quality: exact-match (EM) drop <= 1.0% and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) loss <= 0.015 vs their current model
Also they require KMS with BYOK, SSO (SAML), and 180-day audit log retention. Can we map these to gates and owners?

Zoe (SE): sounds good. need the traffic shape (sustained vs burst) and seq-length distribution to size batching and pick quantization. Also ask for the golden prompt suite (ideally 250 examples).

Rena (Buyer): profile: sustained 28 qps, short bursts to 100 qps for 2-4 minutes, avg input 110 tokens, avg output 70 tokens, tail contexts up to 900 tokens (very rare). Monthly projection ~1.4M request-equivalents. We'll upload the golden set today.

Pri (Eng): recommendation: start with a 24-48h hosted canary replay during their peak window, then provision a small dedicated pool (1-2 mid GPUs) with burst autoscale. We'll run fp16 + 8-bit quantized experiments and report p95 + quality metrics. Fallback: automatic traffic shift to baseline ensemble on gate fail.

Zoe (SE): quick perf profile to run (use as canonical workload):
```
{ "sustained_qps": 28, "peak_qps": 100, "p50_seq_len": 160, "p95_seq_len": 700, "duration": "3h" }
```
Primary gate: p95 over that mix.

Harold (AE): propose 4 acceptance gates (final):
1) Performance gate: p95 <= 220ms measured over a rolling 36h canary with error rate <0.4% and no sustained throttling.
2) Cost gate: modeled monthly burn (using their 1.4M projection) <= $275/1M equivalent (we'll show per-token math and sensitivity to batch window).
3) Quality gate: golden-suite EM drop <=1.0% and MRR loss <=0.015; if using quantized model, same thresholds apply.
4) Security gate: KMS BYOK validated, SAML SSO tested, and audit logs accessible for 180 days. SOC2 summary required before kickoff.
If any gate fails, we auto-fallback to their baseline and open an ops postmortem.

Pri (Eng): pricing note: for 1.4M req/mo equivalent, dedicated mini-pool (1x mid GPU + burst to 2x) looks like a better unit-economy than hosted PAYG, but I'll produce both scenarios. ETA for cost sheet: today EOD.

Rena (Buyer): for cost we need explicit reserved vs payg breakdown and sensitivity to batching window (0/10/25ms). Also SLA during sandbox? We need at least 99.5% availability for the dedicated pool during trial.

Zoe (SE): SLA: we can commit to 99.5% for dedicated trial with runbook and alerts. Hosted canary is best-effort for SLA but we'll monitor. Runbook will include automated rollback triggers.

Harold (AE): owners & timeline:
- Today EOD: Rena uploads golden-suite; security-bot attaches SOC2 excerpt and KMS wiring; Pri posts cost scenarios.
- +24h: Zoe runs perf harness and posts p95, error-rate, token burn, and quality diffs (fp16 vs 8-bit).
- +48h: finalize acceptance doc and schedule 30-min review with Rena for sign-off.
Owners: Zoe (perf & runbook), Pri (cost & infra config), Harold (acceptance doc & customer comms).

security-bot: attached: soc2-summary.pdf (internal), kms-byok-flow.txt, saml-example.md :white_check_mark:

Pri (Eng): technical note on quantization: 8-bit gives ~1.6x decoding throughput on our tests, but expect occasional EM regressions on adversarial examples. We'll flag any golden-suite examples that regress >1% in EM. Also we'll include tokenization examples for their payloads (how we compute request-equivalents).

Zoe (SE): perf run sketch to paste into harness:
```
scenario: mixed_replay
sustained_qps: 28
peak_qps: 100
p50_seq_len: 160
p95_seq_len: 700
duration: 3h
metrics: p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_burn,EM,MRR
```
Run fp16 then 8-bit; primary gate uses p95 and EM.

Rena (Buyer): please be explicit in the acceptance doc about rollback contacts, paging list, and MTTR expectations. Also include a short data handling appendix for RAG indices (sandbox retention 14 days by default; option to extend to 90).

Harold (AE): will add rollback matrix and contact list (Zoe -> Pri -> Harold) and MTTR target 30m for traffic rollback. Also include RAG appendix. Thanks team :thumbsup:
